key_insight: ReAl is a model-agnostic plug-in that refines pretrained neural PDE surrogates by learning high-frequency residuals and aligning rollouts for long-horizon stability.
engineering_relevance: It improves surrogate fidelity for simulations where fine-scale structures and stable autoregressive forecasts are critical, without requiring a new base PDE model.
method: Refinement: a conditional flow-matching model learns the residual distribution around the deterministic base prediction.
Alignment: multiple trajectories are sampled from the same input and used to reinforce the refiner with trajectory-level rewards.
Outcome: the plug-in reconstructs missing fine-scale details while reducing rollout drift in chaotic dynamics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments across diverse surrogate architectures and PDE tasks, showing consistent gains in high-frequency fidelity, forecasting accuracy, and long-horizon stability.
watch_item: Trajectory-level alignment may increase training and sampling cost, and performance could depend on the quality of the pretrained base surrogate and reward design.
paper_title: ReAl: Refine neural operators via aligning dynamical flow
